decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposal would, by reason of its prominent position, size and appearance, represent an unduly obtrusive development which would be detrimental to the visual amenity of the locality.  The proposal is therefore contrary to policies ENV.1.1 and ENV.1.7 of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan and policies ENV-B.1.1 and ENV-B.1.4 of the Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 2 - The proposal would, by reason of its prominent position, excessive size and appearance, represent a significant distraction to motorists on the adjoining highways and is therefore likely to result in conditions that would prejudice pedestrian safety and the free flow of traffic.  The proposal is therefore contrary to policies ENV.1.1 and ENV.1.7 of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan and policies ENV-B.1.1 and ENV-B.1.4 of the Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan.
description: Erection of freestand structure for the purpose of display fronting Hounslow Road
